name: Biển Hồ
summary: Biển Hồ is a volcanic crater lake about 7 km north of Pleiku on the provincial scenic list, also called Hồ T’Nưng. The province describes it as a trace of three extinct volcanoes. Come at first light for mist on the water. Boat rules and tickets are check on arrival.
getThere: About 7 km north of Pleiku; turn from Phạm Văn Đồng at the Biển Hồ junction
